summary: Tested external UI, validation, image upload, mobile layout, history loading, and live assessment submission. Intake, validation, upload preview/rejection, history GET, and basic responsive behavior pass; POST /api/assessments fails with 500 before AI generation.

critical.issue: Every valid assessment submission returns 500. Backend traceback shows TypeError: unhashable type: 'set' at server.py line 88 because model_dump_json uses exclude={{"image_base64"}} instead of exclude={"image_base64"}.

integration_issues.issue: Form displays generic error after backend 500; results, persistence, history item, and prior-result opening cannot be reached until backend fix.

issues: At 390px viewport the 68px sidebar still renders nav labels, causing visible wrapping/clipping (New assessment and Assessment history); icons-only or a mobile drawer would preserve readability.

action_items: Fix the double-brace set expression in backend/server.py line 88, then retest POST /api/assessments and the full result/history/new-assessment flow.
Adjust mobile sidebar navigation so labels do not wrap or clip at 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: The primary user journey is blocked by a deterministic TypeError in generate_advice before the Emergent LLM call; add a regression test for valid assessment creation.
AssessmentCreate has no min-length validation for required strings, so whitespace-only values can reach the AI prompt; consider Pydantic validation after restoring the core flow.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; no assessment was persisted because POST failed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: External app loaded. Required form validation, JPG/PNG/WEBP preview, unsupported GIF rejection, GET /api/assessments, and mobile no-horizontal-overflow passed. Live POST failed before AI invocation; history records and result rendering remain untested.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: fill structure name and blast context, click Generate ranked techniques. Backend traceback reaches generate_advice and evaluates payload.model_dump_json(exclude={{"image_base64"}}), where the inner braces create a set containing a set, raising TypeError. Replace with exclude={"image_base64"} (or equivalent valid set) and rerun the end-to-end flow.
